To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the digital library is a new type of information system which is a hybrid of the library and information retrieval system; (2) the digital library system is a new type which has the following characteristics: (a) a hybrid system which is based on a library system and an information retrieval system, (b) a hybrid system that is a combination of the traditional library system and an advanced information retrieval system which includes the following components: a user interface, a search engine, a document management

the most important features of a modern digital library system are: - A search engine which supports conceptual searching and provides a visualized search result; - A white-list of trusted resources; - Adaptive interfaces which are tailored to individual user needs and preferences.
A Digital Library is not a collection of documents, but rather a system of services that provides access to information resources and supports their use."

the digital library is an important part of the future of the information society and it is important to develop it as such.

the digital library system is a much more complex entity than has previously been recognized and that it is not sufficient to simply provide access to documents.
